placeholderGitignore: One rule per line, for example /assets/*.pdf
placeholderSql: One condition per line, for example type != 'l'
saveUnverified: The saved content could not be read back, please reopen and check it
discardText: Your changes will be lost after closing.
switchText: Switching files discards the unsaved changes of the current file.
conflictText: The ignore file was modified by SiYuan or another tool while you were editing. Saving now overwrites those changes.
bomNotice: This file starts with a UTF-8 BOM; the kernel keeps it, so the first line stops working. Saving removes the BOM.
descSyncignore: Controls which files take part in data sync and snapshots; paths are relative to the data directory.
guideSyncignore1: One rule per line, such as /assets/, /assets/*.pdf or **/temp/**; # starts a comment and ! negates a rule.
guideSyncignore2: Use / as the separator; the kernel treats a backslash as a regex escape and a wrong one disables the whole rule.
guideSyncignore3: The kernel appends its own rules (/.siyuan/conf.json, the user guide, /storage/view-state.json, ...), so they do not belong here.
guideSyncignore4: Saved rules take effect on the next data sync.
descIndexignore: Controls which documents stay out of the index: they disappear from search, backlinks and the outline while the files remain.
guideIndexignore1: One rule per line; paths carry the notebook ID, like /20210808180117-6v0mkx5/temp/**.
guideIndexignore2: The notebook ID is the directory name under data, so check it before writing a rule.
guideIndexignore3: Same syntax as .gitignore: # comments, ! negation, * and ** wildcards.
guideIndexignore4: Only the index is affected, no file changes; it applies after the index is rebuilt.
descEmbeddingignore: Controls which documents stay out of the AI vector index; a missing file means nothing is ignored.
guideEmbeddingignore1: One rule per line; paths carry the notebook ID, like /20210808180117-6v0mkx5/private/**.
guideEmbeddingignore2: Same syntax as .gitignore: # comments, ! negation, * and ** wildcards.
guideEmbeddingignore3: Only the vector index is affected, not search or sync.
guideEmbeddingignore4: The kernel never creates this file; saving creates it.
descSearchignore: Controls which blocks are excluded from search results; every line is an SQL condition appended with AND to a query on the blocks table.
guideSearchignore1: One condition per line, such as type != 'l' or box != '20210808180117-6v0mkx5'.
guideSearchignore2: These are SQL fragments, not ignore rules: # is not a comment and a trailing blank line breaks the query.
guideSearchignore3: Columns come from the blocks table: type, subtype, box, path, hpath, content, memo, tag and so on.
guideSearchignore4: The same conditions also filter the virtual reference candidates for names, aliases and document titles.
descRefsearchignore: Controls which reference texts are left out of the virtual reference candidates; every line is an SQL condition on the refs table.
guideRefsearchignore1: One condition per line, such as content != 'TODO'.
guideRefsearchignore2: It is appended to SELECT DISTINCT content FROM refs with AND, and # is not a comment.
guideRefsearchignore3: Columns come from the refs table: content, block_id, def_block_id, box, path and so on.
guideRefsearchignore4: Only the anchor text candidates are affected, not the blocks in search results.
descAssetsCleanupIgnore: Controls which assets survive unused-asset cleanup; paths are relative to the data directory. Needs SiYuan 3.8.11-alpha.2 or later.
guideAssetsCleanupIgnore1: One rule per line, such as /assets/example.png or /assets/plugin/**; # starts a comment and ! drops the protection.
guideAssetsCleanupIgnore2: Only files under assets matter: rules match real paths relative to the data directory, not document links or URLs.
guideAssetsCleanupIgnore3: Later rules override earlier ones; the protection changes neither reference counting nor manual file deletion.
guideAssetsCleanupIgnore4: The rules take part in data sync; older kernels ignore them during cleanup.
lintEmptyNegation: Line {line} is only ! with no rule, so the rule cannot compile
lintInvalidEscape: Line {line} has an invalid backslash escape, so the rule cannot compile
lintUnclosedClass: Line {line} has an unclosed [, so the rule cannot compile
lintUnbalancedGroup: Line {line} has unbalanced parentheses, so the rule cannot compile
lintBadRepetition: Line {line} misuses + or {…}, so the rule cannot compile
lintStarInClass: Line {line} has a * inside a character class, so the rule cannot compile
lintBadClassRange: Line {line} has a reversed character class range, so the rule cannot compile
lintConflictMarker: Line {line} is a leftover merge conflict marker, so SiYuan refuses to read the whole file
lintStrictNote: These rules are not skipped: SiYuan stops unused-asset cleanup with an error until they are fixed.
lintEmptyLine: Line {line} is blank and produces a dangling AND, which breaks search
lintCommentLine: Line {line} starts with #, which is not a comment here and breaks the query
lintUnbalancedQuote: Line {line} has an unpaired single quote, so the SQL cannot parse
lintUnbalancedParen: Line {line} has unbalanced parentheses, so the SQL cannot parse
lintStatementSeparator: Line {line} contains a semicolon, which turns the query into several statements
lintDanglingOperator: Line {line} leaves an operator dangling: a leading AND/OR or a missing value
